transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. To start, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise, like gardening, after 1 week.  
Just avoid heavy lifting or strenuous work for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.  
If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That’s helpful to know. I’m feeling quite sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
A bit of light sensitivity can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lenses.  
If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses outside should help.

But if the light causes significant pain, or the eye is red and painful, that is not normal and may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for clarifying that. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Yes, vision is not always completely clear in the first week after surgery. It should improve quickly and settle down over time.  
If it is still blurry, or getting more blurry, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that covers everything I wanted to ask. Thank you for all the information!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you for your help!

verdict.label: pass

All points were covered.
